# Command reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_command_docs.py from spritewright/cli.py - do not edit by hand. -->

All commands of `spritewright` 0.1.0. Run them as `spritewright <command>` (installed) or
`python spritewright.py <command>` (source checkout); `spritewright <command> -h` prints the same
information.

General rules:

- `SRC` is a sprite source: a grid `.json`, a rig `.json` or a `.py` drawing script, given as a path or
  as a project-relative name (`examples/sprites/hero.py`). Formats: [sprite-grid-format.md](sprite-grid-format.md).
- Every command accepts `--verbose`. Default output is one line (`check`: one summary line plus one line
  per WARN/FAIL; `build`: at most 5 lines; `context`: at most 15 lines). Files written are identical in
  both modes.
- Exit codes: `0` success, `1` a quality check failed (`check`, `build`) or a game/character is missing
  (`context`, `game-style`), `2` an error (bad input, missing file, invalid option).
- Values that start with `-` must be attached with `=`: `--to=-1,0`, `--dx=-1`, `--offset=-3,0`.
- Default folders are relative to the current directory: `output/<project>/` for single-sprite commands
  (env `SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUT`), `outputs/` for games (`--root` or env `SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUTS`),
  `projects/` for loose sprite projects (env `SPRITEWRIGHT_PROJECTS`). Palettes are looked up as
  described in [palettes/README.md](../palettes/README.md).

## Overview

**Game / character pipeline (`outputs/<Game>/`)**

- [`build`](#build) - ONE call: run source/make_*.py, render, check (incl. game style), sheets; --final (default) also GIFs, unity notes, atlas, archive, card, README + review/&lt;Anim&gt;_contact.png; --draft only review/draft sheets + check. &lt;= 5 lines; exit 1 on FAIL
- [`context`](#context) - compact style + character summary (&lt;= 15 lines) to draw from; one line and exit 1 if the game/character is missing
- [`game-new`](#game-new) - create outputs/&lt;Game&gt;/ style guide: game-style.md/.json, palette.hex, palette_preview.png
- [`game-style`](#game-style) - print + validate a game's style guide (exit 1 if invalid)
- [`game-palette-add`](#game-palette-add) - add ONE user-approved colour with a role to the game palette (updates hex/json/md/preview)
- [`char-new`](#char-new) - create a character card outputs/&lt;Game&gt;/characters/&lt;Char&gt;/character.md (+ .json, source/&lt;Char&gt;_palette.json)
- [`char-export`](#char-export) - export a character source into animations/&lt;Anim&gt;/ (sheet png/json, preview gif, unity-import-note.md), all-animations atlas, archive old versions, update card + outputs/README.md
- [`outputs-index`](#outputs-index) - regenerate outputs/README.md (games, characters, animations)

**Review / quality**

- [`check`](#check) - quality report PASS/WARN/FAIL for a sprite source and/or a Unity atlas (atlas.json / atlas.png / folder); exit code 1 on any FAIL. -o = report .json path or folder
- [`contact`](#contact) - contact sheet of all frames in ONE image, numbered (sprite source, or exported atlas/sheet .json/.png); scale auto-reduced to keep width &lt;= --max-width
- [`inspect`](#inspect) - magnified region with grid + coordinates (region required: -r x,y,w,h)
- [`preview`](#preview) - onion-skin preview of two frames
- [`diff`](#diff) - highlight changed pixels between two frames in red
- [`info`](#info) - show sprite info (frames, animations, loop diffs)
- [`validate`](#validate) - parse a sprite and report errors precisely
- [`ascii`](#ascii) - print a frame as a text grid with legend
- [`clean`](#clean) - report orphan pixels (optionally --remove)
- [`blueprint`](#blueprint) - character proportion guide (16/32/48 chibi/normal; other sizes scaled, approximate): table + JSON + PNG (-o = folder, default output/blueprints/)

**Output / export**

- [`render`](#render) - render one frame to PNG
- [`sheet`](#sheet) - sprite sheet PNG + JSON (Aseprite/Godot/Unity friendly)
- [`gif`](#gif) - animated GIF (or --apng)
- [`unity-sheet`](#unity-sheet) - Unity sheet: fixed cells, foot-pivot aligned strips + atlas + atlas.json + preview/ + UNITY_IMPORT.txt (-o = output folder, default output/&lt;project&gt;/)
- [`export-json`](#export-json) - save any source (e.g. .py) as a grid .json
- [`run`](#run) - run a .py drawing script with spritewright importable

**Palettes**

- [`palettes`](#palettes) - list available palettes (bundled + palette folders)
- [`palette-show`](#palette-show) - print a palette (and optional swatch PNG)
- [`palette-create`](#palette-create) - create a custom palette (.json/.hex) from colors
- [`attach-palette`](#attach-palette) - switch a sprite to another palette (remap colors)
- [`ramp`](#ramp) - generate a hue-shifted color ramp
- [`quantize`](#quantize) - convert a PNG to a palette (optional downscale/dither)

**Editing (overwrite the source .json unless -o)**

- [`new`](#new) - create a new project sprite (blank grid json + notes.md)
- [`outline`](#outline) - auto-outline frames (writes back to source unless -o)
- [`shade`](#shade) - shade-assist: light from a side using a ramp
- [`frame`](#frame) - frame tools: copy, shift, flip-h, flip-v, mirror, recolor, onion, loopcheck, delete

**Animation**

- [`templates`](#templates) - list animation templates (idle, walk, run, jump, attack, hurt, death)
- [`anim-apply`](#anim-apply) - generate a rig animation from a template into a rig .json (writes back to the source unless -o)
- [`tween`](#tween) - tween a rig part (--part) or a frame region (--region) between offsets with easing; integer pixels (writes back to the source unless -o)
- [`oscillate`](#oscillate) - sine motion (breathing/floating/bounce) of a rig part or frame region; integer pixels (writes back to the source unless -o)

**Import / cleanup**

- [`import`](#import) - import a PNG / sprite sheet / Unity atlas back into a grid JSON sprite (atlas.json next to the PNG is read automatically; -o = sprite .json path)
- [`depixelize`](#depixelize) - clean up fake / upscaled pixel art: detect the block grid, 1 block -&gt; 1 pixel, optional palette / K colours, PNG (+ sprite json)
- [`grid-detect`](#grid-detect) - detect block size / offset / confidence of upscaled pixel art (report only)

**Setup**

- [`install-skill`](#install-skill) - install the Claude Code skill (SKILL.md + reference/) into ~/.claude/skills/spritewright/

## Game / character pipeline (`outputs/<Game>/`)

### `build`

ONE call: run source/make_*.py, render, check (incl. game style), sheets; --final (default) also GIFs, unity notes, atlas, archive, card, README + review/&lt;Anim&gt;_contact.png; --draft only review/draft sheets + check. &lt;= 5 lines; exit 1 on FAIL.

```text
spritewright build game character [animation] [--verbose] [--draft] [--final] [--src SRC] [--fps FPS] [--no-loop NO_LOOP] [--preview-scale PREVIEW_SCALE] [--kind {character,prop,tile}] [--json] [--root ROOT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `game` | game name (folder under outputs/) |
| `character` | character name |
| `[animation]` | animation name or 'all' (default) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--draft` | check + per-animation sheet only (review/draft/) |
| `--final` | full delivery (default) |
| `--src` `SRC` | source file (default: auto from the character's source/) |
| `--fps` `FPS` | fps for animations without fps in the source |
| `--no-loop` `NO_LOOP` | comma list of animations exported with loop=false |
| `--preview-scale` `PREVIEW_SCALE` | GIF preview scale (final) (default `4`) |
| `--kind` `{character,prop,tile}` | characters/ (default), props/ or tiles/ |
| `--json` | machine-readable report |
| `--root` `ROOT` | outputs root (default ./outputs, or env SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUTS) |

### `context`

Compact style + character summary (&lt;= 15 lines) to draw from; one line and exit 1 if the game/character is missing.

```text
spritewright context game [character] [--verbose] [--kind {character,prop,tile}] [--root ROOT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `game` | game name (folder under outputs/) |
| `[character]` | character name (omit for the game summary only) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--kind` `{character,prop,tile}` | characters/ (default), props/ or tiles/ |
| `--root` `ROOT` | outputs root (default ./outputs, or env SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUTS) |

### `game-new`

Create outputs/&lt;Game&gt;/ style guide: game-style.md/.json, palette.hex, palette_preview.png.

```text
spritewright game-new name [--verbose] [--mood MOOD] [--temperature TEMPERATURE] [--saturation SATURATION] [--contrast CONTRAST] [--cell CELL] [--ppu PPU] [--outline OUTLINE] [--light LIGHT] [--shading SHADING] [--dither DITHER] [--max-colors MAX_COLORS] [--proportions PROPORTIONS] [--palette PALETTE] [--colors COLORS] [--roles ROLES] [--description DESCRIPTION] [--force] [--root ROOT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `name` | game name ('aurora quest' -&gt; Aurora_Quest) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--mood` `MOOD` | comma list of mood keywords, e.g. cozy,retro |
| `--temperature` `TEMPERATURE` | warm \| cool \| neutral (default `neutral`) |
| `--saturation` `SATURATION` | low \| medium \| high (default `medium`) |
| `--contrast` `CONTRAST` | low \| medium \| high (default `medium`) |
| `--cell` `CELL` | cell size WxH for every sprite (default 32x32) |
| `--ppu` `PPU` | Pixels Per Unit (default: rule from cell height) |
| `--outline` `OUTLINE` | selective \| black \| none (default `selective`) |
| `--light` `LIGHT` | top-left \| top \| top-right \| left \| right \| ... \| front (default `top-left`) |
| `--shading` `SHADING` | shading layers per material 1..4 (default 2) |
| `--dither` `DITHER` | none \| limited \| yes (default `none`) |
| `--max-colors` `MAX_COLORS` | max colours per sprite (default 16) |
| `--proportions` `PROPORTIONS` | chibi \| normal (default `chibi`) |
| `--palette` `PALETTE` | base palette name / .hex / .json (default pico-8) |
| `--colors` `COLORS` | pick N (8-32) colours of the base palette (default all, max 32) |
| `--roles` `ROLES` | role overrides: JSON file or '3=skin,#ffec27=gold' |
| `--description` `DESCRIPTION` | one-paragraph description (default: generated) |
| `--force` | overwrite an existing style guide (only on request) |
| `--root` `ROOT` | outputs root (default ./outputs, or env SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUTS) |

### `game-style`

Print + validate a game's style guide (exit 1 if invalid).

```text
spritewright game-style game [--verbose] [--json] [--root ROOT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `game` | game name (folder under outputs/) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--json` | print game-style.json |
| `--root` `ROOT` | outputs root (default ./outputs, or env SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUTS) |

### `game-palette-add`

Add ONE user-approved colour with a role to the game palette (updates hex/json/md/preview).

```text
spritewright game-palette-add game hex [--verbose] --role ROLE [--root ROOT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `game` | game name (folder under outputs/) |
| `hex` | RRGGBB |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--role` `ROLE` | unique role, e.g. lava (required) |
| `--root` `ROOT` | outputs root (default ./outputs, or env SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUTS) |

### `char-new`

Create a character card outputs/&lt;Game&gt;/characters/&lt;Char&gt;/character.md (+ .json, source/&lt;Char&gt;_palette.json).

```text
spritewright char-new game name [--verbose] [--role ROLE] [--design DESIGN] [--cell CELL] [--pivot PIVOT] [--colors COLORS] [--kind {character,prop,tile}] [--force] [--root ROOT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `game` | game name (folder under outputs/) |
| `name` | character name ('erica' -&gt; Erica) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--role` `ROLE` | character role, e.g. 'player, healer' |
| `--design` `DESIGN` | short design note |
| `--cell` `CELL` | cell override WxH (default: game cell) |
| `--pivot` `PIVOT` | x,y sprite pixel \| bottom-center \| center (default: union bottom-center) |
| `--colors` `COLORS` | comma list of game palette roles / indices / hex (default: whole palette) |
| `--kind` `{character,prop,tile}` | characters/ (default), props/ or tiles/ |
| `--force` | rewrite an existing card (keeps animations/log) |
| `--root` `ROOT` | outputs root (default ./outputs, or env SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUTS) |

### `char-export`

Export a character source into animations/&lt;Anim&gt;/ (sheet png/json, preview gif, unity-import-note.md), all-animations atlas, archive old versions, update card + outputs/README.md.

```text
spritewright char-export game name src [--verbose] [--anims ANIMS] [--fps FPS] [--no-loop NO_LOOP] [--preview-scale PREVIEW_SCALE] [--kind {character,prop,tile}] [--root ROOT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `game` | game name (folder under outputs/) |
| `name` | character name |
| `src` | sprite source (.py / rig json / grid json; relative -&gt; the character's source/) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--anims` `ANIMS` | comma list, e.g. Idle,Walk (default: all animations of the source) |
| `--fps` `FPS` | fps for animations without fps in the source |
| `--no-loop` `NO_LOOP` | comma list of animations exported with loop=false |
| `--preview-scale` `PREVIEW_SCALE` | GIF preview scale (default 4) |
| `--kind` `{character,prop,tile}` | characters/ (default), props/ or tiles/ |
| `--root` `ROOT` | outputs root (default ./outputs, or env SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUTS) |

### `outputs-index`

Regenerate outputs/README.md (games, characters, animations).

```text
spritewright outputs-index [--verbose] [--root ROOT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--root` `ROOT` | outputs root (default ./outputs, or env SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUTS) |

## Review / quality

### `check`

Quality report PASS/WARN/FAIL for a sprite source and/or a Unity atlas (atlas.json / atlas.png / folder); exit code 1 on any FAIL. -o = report .json path or folder.

```text
spritewright check src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--atlas ATLAS] [--no-atlas] [--palette PALETTE] [--max-colors MAX_COLORS] [--size-drift SIZE_DRIFT] [--size-drift-fail SIZE_DRIFT_FAIL] [--foot-drift FOOT_DRIFT] [--foot-drift-fail FOOT_DRIFT_FAIL] [--motion-min-px MOTION_MIN_PX] [--motion-min-ratio MOTION_MIN_RATIO] [--seam-factor SEAM_FACTOR] [--orphans ORPHANS] [--connectivity {4,8}] [--json] [--no-write] [--game GAME] [--root ROOT]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--atlas` `ATLAS` | atlas to check with the source (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/atlas.json if it was made from this source) |
| `--no-atlas` | check only the source frames |
| `--palette` `PALETTE` | palette for atlas-only checks (default: atlas meta.source) |
| `--max-colors` `MAX_COLORS` | max distinct colours per PNG/sprite (default 16) -&gt; WARN |
| `--size-drift` `SIZE_DRIFT` | bbox w/h change px -&gt; WARN above (default 2) |
| `--size-drift-fail` `SIZE_DRIFT_FAIL` | bbox w/h change px -&gt; FAIL above (default 6) |
| `--foot-drift` `FOOT_DRIFT` | foot vs pivot px -&gt; WARN above (default 1) |
| `--foot-drift-fail` `FOOT_DRIFT_FAIL` | foot vs pivot px -&gt; FAIL above (default 4) |
| `--motion-min-px` `MOTION_MIN_PX` | min px difference between frames (default 2) |
| `--motion-min-ratio` `MOTION_MIN_RATIO` | min difference as share of opaque px (default 0.01) |
| `--seam-factor` `SEAM_FACTOR` | loop seam &gt; factor x median step -&gt; WARN (default 2) |
| `--orphans` `ORPHANS` | orphan pixels per frame -&gt; WARN above (default 3) |
| `--connectivity` `{4,8}` | orphan connectivity (default 4, as clean) |
| `--json` | print the JSON report instead of the text summary |
| `--no-write` | do not save check .json/.txt files |
| `--game` `GAME` | also check game-style compliance against outputs/&lt;Game&gt;/game-style.json (auto when the path is inside outputs/&lt;Game&gt;/) |
| `--root` `ROOT` | outputs root for --game (default ./outputs or env SPRITEWRIGHT_OUTPUTS) |

### `contact`

Contact sheet of all frames in ONE image, numbered (sprite source, or exported atlas/sheet .json/.png); scale auto-reduced to keep width &lt;= --max-width.

```text
spritewright contact src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [-s SCALE] [--columns COLUMNS] [--max-width MAX_WIDTH]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `-s`, `--scale` `SCALE` | default 4 (reduced automatically if too wide) |
| `--columns` `COLUMNS` | frames per row (default: automatic) |
| `--max-width` `MAX_WIDTH` | max image width in px (default 1024, 0 = no limit) |

### `inspect`

Magnified region with grid + coordinates (region required: -r x,y,w,h).

```text
spritewright inspect src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [-f FRAME] [-r REGION] [--full] [-z ZOOM] [--indices]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `-f`, `--frame` `FRAME` | frame name or 1-based index (default: first frame) |
| `-r`, `--region` `REGION` | x,y,w,h (required unless --full) |
| `--full` | whole frame (the old default) |
| `-z`, `--zoom` `ZOOM` | screen px per sprite pixel (default 24) |
| `--indices` | print palette index in each cell |

### `preview`

Onion-skin preview of two frames.

```text
spritewright preview src a b [-o OUT] [--verbose] [-s SCALE]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `a` | first frame (name or 1-based index) |
| `b` | second frame (name or 1-based index) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `-s`, `--scale` `SCALE` | integer upscale factor (default 8) |

### `diff`

Highlight changed pixels between two frames in red.

```text
spritewright diff src a b [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--other OTHER] [-s SCALE]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `a` | first frame (name or 1-based index) |
| `b` | second frame (name or 1-based index) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--other` `OTHER` | take frame b from another sprite source |
| `-s`, `--scale` `SCALE` | integer upscale factor (default 8) |

Show sprite info (frames, animations, loop diffs).


| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |

### `validate`

Parse a sprite and report errors precisely.

```text
spritewright validate src [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |

### `ascii`

Print a frame as a text grid with legend.

```text
spritewright ascii src [--verbose] [-f FRAME]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `-f`, `--frame` `FRAME` | frame name or 1-based index (default: first frame) |

### `clean`

Report orphan pixels (optionally --remove).

```text
spritewright clean src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [-f FRAME] [--remove] [--isolated-only] [--connectivity {4,8}]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `-f`, `--frame` `FRAME` | frame name/index or 'all' (default all) |
| `--remove` | remove them (isolated -&gt; transparent, others -&gt; most common neighbour colour) |
| `--isolated-only` | only pixels with no opaque neighbour at all |
| `--connectivity` `{4,8}` | neighbourhood (default 4) |

### `blueprint`

Character proportion guide (16/32/48 chibi/normal; other sizes scaled, approximate): table + JSON + PNG (-o = folder, default output/blueprints/).

```text
spritewright blueprint [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--size SIZE] [--all] [--style STYLE] [-s SCALE] [--overlay OVERLAY] [-f FRAME] [--json]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--size` `SIZE` | N or WxH (repeatable; default 32) |
| `--all` | 16, 32 and 48 |
| `--style` `STYLE` | chibi \| normal (default `chibi`) |
| `-s`, `--scale` `SCALE` | PNG scale (default ~512 px wide grid) |
| `--overlay` `OVERLAY` | sprite source drawn faintly under the guide (same size) |
| `-f`, `--frame` `FRAME` | overlay frame |
| `--json` | print JSON instead of the table |

## Output / export

### `render`

Render one frame to PNG.

```text
spritewright render src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [-f FRAME] [-s SCALE] [--bg BG]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `-f`, `--frame` `FRAME` | frame name or 1-based index (default: first frame) |
| `-s`, `--scale` `SCALE` | integer upscale factor (default 8) |
| `--bg` `BG` | background hex or 'checker' (default transparent) |

### `sheet`

Sprite sheet PNG + JSON (Aseprite/Godot/Unity friendly).

```text
spritewright sheet src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [-s SCALE] [--columns COLUMNS] [--padding PADDING]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `-s`, `--scale` `SCALE` | integer upscale factor (default 1) |
| `--columns` `COLUMNS` | frames per row (default: up to 8) |
| `--padding` `PADDING` | transparent px between frames (default 0) |

### `gif`

Animated GIF (or --apng).

```text
spritewright gif src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [-a ANIM] [--fps FPS] [-s SCALE] [--bg BG] [--apng]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `-a`, `--anim` `ANIM` | animation to export (default: all frames in order) |
| `--fps` `FPS` | frames per second (default: the frame durations) |
| `-s`, `--scale` `SCALE` | integer upscale factor (default 8) |
| `--bg` `BG` | solid background color (default transparent) |
| `--apng` | write an animated PNG instead of a GIF |

### `unity-sheet`

Unity sheet: fixed cells, foot-pivot aligned strips + atlas + atlas.json + preview/ + UNITY_IMPORT.txt (-o = output folder, default output/&lt;project&gt;/).

```text
spritewright unity-sheet src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--cell CELL] [--padding PADDING] [--pivot PIVOT] [--align {fixed,auto}] [--anchor ANCHOR] [--fps FPS] [--no-loop NO_LOOP] [--anims ANIMS] [--preview-scale PREVIEW_SCALE] [--ppu PPU]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--cell` `CELL` | fixed cell WxH (default: auto from content + padding) |
| `--padding` `PADDING` | auto-cell padding around content (default 1) |
| `--pivot` `PIVOT` | bottom-center \| center \| auto \| x,y (sprite pixel of the foot) |
| `--align` `{fixed,auto}` | fixed: one pivot for all frames (keeps bob/jump, default); auto: per-frame foot |
| `--anchor` `ANCHOR` | x,y cell pixel receiving the pivot (needs --cell; default bottom-center) |
| `--fps` `FPS` | fps for animations without fps in the source |
| `--no-loop` `NO_LOOP` | comma list of animations exported with loop=false (e.g. death) |
| `--anims` `ANIMS` | comma list: export only these animations, in this row order |
| `--preview-scale` `PREVIEW_SCALE` | preview/ scale (0 = no previews) (default `4`) |
| `--ppu` `PPU` | Pixels Per Unit to recommend (default: rule from cell height) |

### `export-json`

Save any source (e.g. .py) as a grid .json.

```text
spritewright export-json src [-o OUT] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |

### `run`

Run a .py drawing script with spritewright importable.

```text
spritewright run script [rest ...] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `script` | drawing script (.py) |
| `[rest ...]` | arguments passed to the script |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |

## Palettes

### `palettes`

List available palettes (bundled + palette folders).

```text
spritewright palettes [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |

### `palette-show`

Print a palette (and optional swatch PNG).

```text
spritewright palette-show palette [-o OUT] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `palette` | palette name or .hex/.json path |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |

### `palette-create`

Create a custom palette (.json/.hex) from colors.

```text
spritewright palette-create out colors [colors ...] [--verbose] [--name NAME] [--base BASE] [--extend] [--snap]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `out` | output file (.json keeps names); relative -&gt; projects/ |
| `colors [colors ...]` | name=RRGGBB or RRGGBB |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--name` `NAME` | palette name stored in the file |
| `--base` `BASE` | base palette (for --extend / --snap) |
| `--extend` | append colors to the base palette |
| `--snap` | snap given colors to nearest base color |

### `attach-palette`

Switch a sprite to another palette (remap colors).

```text
spritewright attach-palette src palette [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--snap] [--copy-to-project]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `palette` | palette name or .hex/.json path |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--snap` | snap colors not in the new palette to nearest |
| `--copy-to-project` | store palette json next to the sprite |

### `ramp`

Generate a hue-shifted color ramp.

```text
spritewright ramp base [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--steps STEPS] [--hue-shift HUE_SHIFT] [--palette PALETTE]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | base color hex |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--steps` `STEPS` | number of colours (default 5) |
| `--hue-shift` `HUE_SHIFT` | hue shift in degrees across the ramp (default `14`) |
| `--palette` `PALETTE` | snap ramp to this palette |

### `quantize`

Convert a PNG to a palette (optional downscale/dither).

```text
spritewright quantize input [-o OUT] [--verbose] --palette PALETTE [--dither {none,bayer4,floyd}] [--size SIZE] [--resample {box,nearest,lanczos}] [-s SCALE] [--json JSON]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `input` | input image (PNG/JPEG/...) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--palette` `PALETTE` | target palette name or .hex/.json path (required) |
| `--dither` `{none,bayer4,floyd}` | dithering (default none) |
| `--size` `SIZE` | downscale to WxH before quantizing |
| `--resample` `{box,nearest,lanczos}` | downscale filter (default box) |
| `-s`, `--scale` `SCALE` | integer upscale of the output PNG (default 1) |
| `--json` `JSON` | also save as grid sprite json |

## Editing (overwrite the source .json unless -o)

### `new`

Create a new project sprite (blank grid json + notes.md).

```text
spritewright new project name [--verbose] [--size SIZE] [--palette PALETTE] [--frames FRAMES]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `project` | project folder under projects/ |
| `name` | sprite name (file stem) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--size` `SIZE` | WxH (default 32x32) |
| `--palette` `PALETTE` | palette name or path (default pico-8) |
| `--frames` `FRAMES` | comma list of frame names (default idle1) |

### `outline`

Auto-outline frames (writes back to source unless -o).

```text
spritewright outline src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [-f FRAME] [--color COLOR] [--selective] [--connectivity {4,8}] [--steps STEPS] [--inside]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `-f`, `--frame` `FRAME` | frame name/index or 'all' (default all) |
| `--color` `COLOR` | outline colour (index, role name or in-palette hex) |
| `--selective` | selective outline: a darker shade of the adjacent colour |
| `--connectivity` `{4,8}` | 8 includes diagonal corners, 4 does not (default 8) |
| `--steps` `STEPS` | selective: palette steps darker (default 1) |
| `--inside` | recolor the shape's own edge instead of growing outward |

### `shade`

Shade-assist: light from a side using a ramp.

```text
spritewright shade src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [-f FRAME] [--mask-color MASK_COLOR] [-r REGION] [--ramp RAMP] [--light LIGHT] [--depth DEPTH] [--shadow-depth SHADOW_DEPTH]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `-f`, `--frame` `FRAME` | frame name/index or 'all' (default all) |
| `--mask-color` `MASK_COLOR` | shade pixels of this color (default all opaque) |
| `-r`, `--region` `REGION` | x,y,w,h region to shade (default all opaque) |
| `--ramp` `RAMP` | comma list dark-&gt;light |
| `--light` `LIGHT` | light direction, e.g. top-left, top, right (default top-left) |
| `--depth` `DEPTH` | lit band width in px (default 1) |
| `--shadow-depth` `SHADOW_DEPTH` | shadow band width in px (default: --depth) |

### `frame`

Frame tools: copy, shift, flip-h, flip-v, mirror, recolor, onion, loopcheck, delete.

```text
spritewright frame src action [a] [b] [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--dx DX] [--dy DY] [--wrap] [--direction {lr,rl,tb,bt}] [--map MAP] [--anim ANIM] [-s SCALE]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `action` | frame operation |
| `[a]` | frame (or source frame / 'all') |
| `[b]` | second frame (copy dst, onion) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--dx` `DX` | shift: x offset in px (negative: --dx=-1) (default `0`) |
| `--dy` `DY` | shift: y offset in px (negative: --dy=-1) (default `0`) |
| `--wrap` | shift: wrap pixels around the edges |
| `--direction` `{lr,rl,tb,bt}` | mirror: copy left-&gt;right, right-&gt;left, top-&gt;bottom or bottom-&gt;top (default lr) |
| `--map` `MAP` | recolor map a=b,c=d |
| `--anim` `ANIM` | loopcheck: animation to check |
| `-s`, `--scale` `SCALE` | onion: integer upscale factor (default 8) |

## Animation

### `templates`

List animation templates (idle, walk, run, jump, attack, hurt, death).

```text
spritewright templates [--verbose] [--show SHOW] [--templates TEMPLATES]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--show` `SHOW` | print one template's data as JSON |
| `--templates` `TEMPLATES` | template JSON file (default: the bundled anim_templates.json) |

### `anim-apply`

Generate a rig animation from a template into a rig .json (writes back to the source unless -o).

```text
spritewright anim-apply src template [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--frames FRAMES] [--name NAME] [--scale SCALE] [--fps FPS] [--no-loop] [--map MAP] [--view VIEW] [--templates TEMPLATES]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `template` | template name (see: spritewright templates) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--frames` `FRAMES` | frame count (default: template's; walk has 6 and 8 tables) |
| `--name` `NAME` | animation name (default: template name) |
| `--scale` `SCALE` | multiply all pixel offsets (rounded half away from 0) (default `1`) |
| `--fps` `FPS` | override template fps |
| `--no-loop` | force loop=false |
| `--map` `MAP` | role=part overrides, e.g. head=eyes,weapon=staff |
| `--view` `VIEW` | template view, e.g. front (walk/run for front-facing characters) |
| `--templates` `TEMPLATES` | template JSON file |

### `tween`

Tween a rig part (--part) or a frame region (--region) between offsets with easing; integer pixels (writes back to the source unless -o).

```text
spritewright tween src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--anim ANIM] [--part PART] [-r REGION] [--frames FRAMES] [--from FROM] [--to TO] [--keys KEYS] [--start START] [--end END] [--ease EASE] [--add]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--anim` `ANIM` | animation (rig: created with --frames if missing; sprite: frames to use) |
| `--part` `PART` | rig part name |
| `-r`, `--region` `REGION` | x,y,w,h region in frame sprites |
| `--frames` `FRAMES` | rig: animation frame count (create/extend) |
| `--from` `FROM` | start offset dx,dy |
| `--to` `TO` | end offset dx,dy |
| `--keys` `KEYS` | keyframes 'frame:dx,dy[:easing];...' (1-based) |
| `--start` `START` | first frame (1-based) (default `1`) |
| `--end` `END` | last frame (default: last) |
| `--ease` `EASE` | linear, ease_in, ease_out, ease_in_out, smoothstep, ease_out_back, bounce (default `linear`) |
| `--add` | rig: add to existing offsets instead of replacing |

### `oscillate`

Sine motion (breathing/floating/bounce) of a rig part or frame region; integer pixels (writes back to the source unless -o).

```text
spritewright oscillate src [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--anim ANIM] [--part PART] [-r REGION] [--frames FRAMES] --amp AMP --period PERIOD [--phase PHASE] [--axis {x,y}] [--mode {sine,abs,pos}] [--no-loop] [--set]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `src` | sprite source (.json grid / .py script / projects-relative) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--anim` `ANIM` | animation (rig: created with --frames if missing; sprite: frames to use) |
| `--part` `PART` | rig part name |
| `-r`, `--region` `REGION` | x,y,w,h region in frame sprites |
| `--frames` `FRAMES` | rig: animation frame count (create/extend) |
| `--amp` `AMP` | amplitude in px (required) |
| `--period` `PERIOD` | period in frames (should divide frame count) (required) |
| `--phase` `PHASE` | phase as fraction of the period (default `0`) |
| `--axis` `{x,y}` | motion axis (default y) |
| `--mode` `{sine,abs,pos}` | abs = bounce \|sin\| (default `sine`) |
| `--no-loop` | no seamless-loop warning |
| `--set` | rig: replace offsets on that axis instead of adding |

## Import / cleanup

### `import`

Import a PNG / sprite sheet / Unity atlas back into a grid JSON sprite (atlas.json next to the PNG is read automatically; -o = sprite .json path).

```text
spritewright import input [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--project PROJECT] [--name NAME] [--frame FRAME] [--cols COLS] [--rows ROWS] [--margin MARGIN] [--spacing SPACING] [--names NAMES] [--anim ANIM] [--anim-rows ANIM_ROWS] [--atlas ATLAS] [--no-atlas] [--palette PALETTE] [--alpha-threshold ALPHA_THRESHOLD] [--dither {none,bayer4,floyd}] [--skip-empty] [--fps FPS] [--restore-offsets] [--canvas CANVAS] [--report REPORT] [--json]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `input` | PNG (sheet, strip, single frame or atlas.png) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--project` `PROJECT` | write projects/&lt;project&gt;/&lt;name&gt;.json |
| `--name` `NAME` | sprite name / file stem (default: PNG stem) |
| `--frame` `FRAME` | frame size WxH (grid slicing) |
| `--cols` `COLS` | columns (frame size derived when --frame is not given) |
| `--rows` `ROWS` | rows |
| `--margin` `MARGIN` | border around the sheet in px (default `0`) |
| `--spacing` `SPACING` | gap between cells in px (default `0`) |
| `--names` `NAMES` | comma list of frame names (row-major) |
| `--anim` `ANIM` | name all frames &lt;anim&gt;1..N as one animation |
| `--anim-rows` `ANIM_ROWS` | one animation per row, e.g. 'idle:4,walk:6' (count optional) |
| `--atlas` `ATLAS` | atlas.json to use (default: &lt;png&gt;.json / atlas.json next to the PNG) |
| `--no-atlas` | ignore any atlas.json |
| `--palette` `PALETTE` | palette name/.hex/.json or a sprite source whose palette to use (default: atlas source sprite, else exact image colours &lt;= 64) |
| `--alpha-threshold` `ALPHA_THRESHOLD` | alpha &gt;= this -&gt; opaque (default 128) |
| `--dither` `{none,bayer4,floyd}` | dithering when remapping off-palette colours (default none) |
| `--skip-empty` | drop fully transparent cells |
| `--fps` `FPS` | set all frame durations to 1000/fps |
| `--restore-offsets` | atlas: shift cells back by their offsets into the original canvas (source sprite size or --canvas) |
| `--canvas` `CANVAS` | canvas WxH for --restore-offsets |
| `--report` `REPORT` | write the full JSON report here |
| `--json` | print the JSON report |

### `depixelize`

Clean up fake / upscaled pixel art: detect the block grid, 1 block -&gt; 1 pixel, optional palette / K colours, PNG (+ sprite json).

```text
spritewright depixelize input [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--min-size MIN_SIZE] [--max-size MAX_SIZE] [--json-report] [--report-only] [--size SIZE] [--offset OFFSET] [--sample {median,center}] [--palette PALETTE] [--colors COLORS] [--merge MERGE] [--transparent TRANSPARENT] [--tolerance TOLERANCE] [--alpha-threshold ALPHA_THRESHOLD] [-s SCALE] [--sprite SPRITE] [--project PROJECT] [--name NAME]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `input` | image (PNG/JPEG/...) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--min-size` `MIN_SIZE` | smallest block size to test (default 2) |
| `--max-size` `MAX_SIZE` | largest block size to test (default 32) |
| `--json-report` | print the JSON report |
| `--report-only` | only print detected size/offset/confidence |
| `--size` `SIZE` | force the block size (skip detection) |
| `--offset` `OFFSET` | force the grid offset x,y |
| `--sample` `{median,center}` | block colour: median of the block interior or the centre pixel (default median) |
| `--palette` `PALETTE` | snap colours to this palette (name/.hex/.json/sprite) |
| `--colors` `COLORS` | reduce to K colours (k-means) |
| `--merge` `MERGE` | merge colours closer than this dE (0 = off) (default `8`) |
| `--transparent` `TRANSPARENT` | none \| auto (border colour) \| RRGGBB -&gt; transparent (default `none`) |
| `--tolerance` `TOLERANCE` | dE tolerance for --transparent (default `12`) |
| `--alpha-threshold` `ALPHA_THRESHOLD` | alpha &gt;= this -&gt; opaque (default 128) |
| `-s`, `--scale` `SCALE` | also write a nearest-scaled preview (default `0`) |
| `--sprite` `SPRITE` | also import the result as grid json (path) |
| `--project` `PROJECT` | also import into projects/&lt;project&gt;/&lt;name&gt;.json |
| `--name` `NAME` | sprite name for --project |

### `grid-detect`

Detect block size / offset / confidence of upscaled pixel art (report only).

```text
spritewright grid-detect input [-o OUT] [--verbose] [--min-size MIN_SIZE] [--max-size MAX_SIZE] [--json-report]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `input` | image (PNG/JPEG/...) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` | output path (default: output/&lt;project&gt;/...) |
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--min-size` `MIN_SIZE` | smallest block size to test (default 2) |
| `--max-size` `MAX_SIZE` | largest block size to test (default 32) |
| `--json-report` | print the JSON report |

## Setup

### `install-skill`

Install the Claude Code skill (SKILL.md + reference/) into ~/.claude/skills/spritewright/.

```text
spritewright install-skill [--verbose] [--target TARGET] [--dry-run] [--uninstall] [--command COMMAND]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--verbose` | full output (lists, reports, logs); default: one line |
| `--target` `TARGET` | skills root (default ~/.claude/skills); files go to &lt;target&gt;/spritewright/ |
| `--dry-run` | only print what would be written |
| `--uninstall` | remove the installed skill folder |
| `--command` `COMMAND` | command line the skill uses to call the tool (default: the installed 'spritewright' entry point, else python + spritewright.py of this checkout) |
